title: Add Reconcile Policy Fields and Observation Scheduler
intent: Persist reconcile policy for environments and deployment units, and schedule due observations without triggering remediation.
observed_repository_state: domain.ReconcileMode defines observe_only, auto_apply, approval_required, and disabled in internal/domain/deployment_unit.go.
deployment_units.reconcile_mode is persisted by migration 000038 and PgDeploymentUnitRepository.
environments.targeting.default_reconcile_mode is persisted in the targeting JSONB column by migration 000039 and PgEnvironmentRepository.
intended_behavior: The reconciler selects only service/environment state rows due for observation.
Disabled environment or deployment-unit policy prevents scheduled observation.
Non-disabled reconcile modes perform observation and drift-state updates only; remediation is not triggered by this task.
